usage: pactkit board [-h] {add,complete-task,move,list,render} ...

positional arguments:
  {add,complete-task,move,list,render}
    add                 Create one Story record
    complete-task       Complete one Story task
    move                Change one Story workflow status
    list                List Story records
    render              Render the Board projection

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
